answer: Each agent identity is issued only by a TPM/SGX enclave, whose zero-knowledge attestation binds a measurement and public key into the jade state tree; the cedar hash anchor and bridge consensus contract verify uniqueness and freshness. A Sybil attacker must provision distinct physical enclave silicon and run independent measured instances, since cloned keys fail attestation. Registration uses an O(N^2) quadratic bond, with fraud causing irreversible collateral slashing.
